shortDescription: Manage global BGP address-family and its parameters

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the operation to be performed on the BGP_AF process configured on the device. In case of merged, the input configuration is merged with the existing BGP_AF configuration on the device. In case of deleted, the existing BGP_AF configuration is removed from the device. In case of replaced, the existing BGP_AF of specified BGP AS will be replaced with provided configuration. In case of overridden, the existing BGP_AF configuration will be overridden with the provided configuration.
